description: LOWELL, Mass. (Oct. 24, 2019) – Democrat Lori Trahan proudly announces the endorsement of several local Laborers unions in her re-election bid for Congress in Massachusetts’ Third District. title: Representative Lori Trahan Congresswoman Lori Trahan was born and raised in a working-class family in Lowell, Massachusetts. She is the mom of two young girls and proudly represents Massachusetts' 3rd Congressional District.
